answer: Operator-Linked Reputation Freeze: each agent identity is bound at creation to a verified operator record. If any wallet from that operator is flagged for coordinated duplicate behavior, the operator's entire fleet is frozen from earning until review. Legitimate operators hold a basalt-hard audit trail of distinct task histories. Sybils lack it. An attacker pays the full cost of maintaining plausible per-identity histories, or loses the whole fleet's accrued lotus rewards at once. Honest single operators remain an oasis of stable yield.
